preserved_assertions: All existing arithmetic/driver/kernel/HID and 13 guard assertions retained; actual source config/state types replace copied layouts. DYA selects pinned settings archive admission and NVS reload fixtures.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.
execution.coverage: Each gated real function range requires measured executable lines. Actual-entry recording-tool controls reject empty/unrelated/partial reports; normal full runs retain measured coverage and all existing behavioral assertions.
execution.ci: Both supported-core integration variants, digest-pinned image, fresh retained results even on failure; online branch resolution and exact offline pins are distinct

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.

backends.supported: CONFIG_INPUT_MODE_THREAD; default on both supported cores
backends.unsupported: Synchronous input is rejected by the build guard; direct HID writers outside the input thread are not serialized

suppression_scope: No source-button/final-frame policy. Retain scheduled motion token admission, first-axis cancellation and input-thread HID serialization; final source filter is not a global output interceptor.
runtime_settings: Public runtime API, actual-source adapter, all100 percentage round trips and coupled thresholds; real kernel settings cancellation plus DYA registry/NVS reload; tests/README.md
timeout_conversion: Millisecond trigger/report/retry reservations, exact ceil, complete uint16 domain; normal clocks use native32 arithmetic, high rates retain kernel tick width. Host full coverage/width controls and actual Zephyr conversion comparison retained among29 endpoint groups. Physical latency NOT RUN.
running_rearm: An already-running handler must preserve a newer trigger timer without decay/output. Four host/native cases cover move/scroll and armed/active glide, explicit deadlines, exact first reports and post-cancel silence; pre-fix native binary fails the named assertion three times.
expired_rearm: Two real-kernel cases hold an old callback beyond a new trigger deadline and require queued move/scroll work to recover with exact first reports and post-cancel silence. K_FOREVER rescheduling disarms timers without CANCELING; helper disarm targets replace cancel-call targets while all output/state/timing assertions remain. Pre-repair binary reproduces named loss assertion3/3.
composite_frames: 576 host permutations cover all24 four-axis orders, move/scroll, signs, Ctrl and fresh/manual/gliding histories. Real listener preserves original3 reports and appends4 composite/glide/stop reports; payload/sync and cross-stream cancellation remain.
report_cadence: Slots remain owned through HID completion. Four kernel cases enforce100-102ms gaps after consumer or HID handoff delays; four more preserve future/overdue manual triggers across ownership. Pre-repair native binaries reproduce9ms and zero-gap output3/3 each; all19 prior kernel groups retained. These27 groups plus two endpoint failure/recovery groups make29 total.
settings_node_isolation: All20 keys affect only their owner; init still applies all nodes. Host and real DYA registry/NVS checks preserve an unrelated runtime tune and active generation; pre-repair native binary fails3/3 on fresh flash. Extra pointer-comparison sanitizer and ordered registry traversal remove host fixture address assumptions, not a claimed physical firmware defect.
failure_recovery: Eight signed move/scroll host traces assert exact ordered axes/ticks/totals and final stop through two queue refusals, delayed consumption, two endpoint failures and invalid/equal writes. Two native endpoint groups extend27 to29: blocked/repeated EIO then success,100-102ms gaps, actual HID/slot clearing and post-cancel silence. Earlier-driver control must fail the named compressed-recovery assertion3/3. Physical reconnect NOT RUN.
